title: A — 3ペイン
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop application layout proposal for Resume Studio.
Primary request: Design a practical Japanese macOS desktop app for locally editing a resume and career history, with structured fields, WYSIWYG body editing and a generated PDF preview. Show one full application window straight-on filling a wide 16:10 image, with crisp readable Japanese typography. No device frame, no perspective, no marketing website.
Requirements: Project toolbar with 新規, 開く, 保存 and an overflow option for 名前を付けて保存. Project filename sample.json and explicit 未保存の変更 status. Visible switching between 履歴書 and 職務経歴書. Navigation for 基本情報, 学歴・職歴, 免許・資格, 志望動機, 本人希望; career-specific sections 職務要約, 職務経歴, スキル, 自己PR must be reachable when switching documents. Show only relevant section fields instead of every form at once. Basic information has labeled name, furigana, date of birth, document date, address, phone, email and optional photo import. History rows support add, delete, reorder. Rich body text editing offers bold, italic, bullet and numbered lists, undo/redo when applicable. Template selector. Persistent PDF更新 button for MANUAL generation. PDF preview toolbar with previous/next page, 1 / 2, zoom, and a clearly visible amber PDFは更新前の内容です banner. PDF is read-only, never show editable handles on the paper. Export via 書き出す with PDF / TeX一式 and 表示中の書類 / 両方 options in a compact popover or strip. Show a realistic A4 portrait Japanese ruled resume sheet, 2-page navigation, photo placeholder without any real person. Separate 未保存の変更 from PDFは更新前の内容です. Saving is explicit; never imply autosave or automatic PDF refresh. Environment diagnosis in secondary settings, not the main form. All data is fictional: 山田 花子, やまだ はなこ, sample@example.test, 架空県サンプル市. Do not invent cloud sync, login, AI generation, onboarding marketing, or collaboration features. Professional usable interface, 14-16px equivalent labels, strong focus indicators, clear hierarchy, restrained colors, narrow borders, ample field width, independent scrolling panes.

Composition: At a 1440x900 equivalent desktop viewport, a compact 64px global toolbar across the top, then three panes: 200px persistent left sidebar, about 540px center editor, remaining width right PDF preview. Sidebar contains the document switch and section list with 基本情報 active. Center shows 基本情報 heading, two-column name/furigana and birth/document dates, full-width address, phone/email row and compact optional photo import. Right preview remains visible while editing. Template and update controls in the preview header, export in global toolbar. Small bottom status bar. Palette: warm off-white, dark charcoal, restrained deep forest-green active states. Editorial precision, subtle corners, no decorative art.
